purpose: Measure coil growth in the 50 complete axis-flip v4 Adam200 trajectories, then shrink the Adam2000 case-23 coils about its verified magnetic axis and test direct-data Adam repair.

population_audit.effective_radius_definition: mean base-coil arc length divided by 2*pi

shrink_scan.adaptive_refinement: If the coarse scan brackets a valid-to-invalid transition, add intermediate scales inside that bracket before choosing repair starts.
shrink_scan.refit: order-16 least-squares Fourier fit at fixed coil parameter
shrink_scan.surface_role: fixed geometric reference from the source field; not re-solved after coil scaling

repair.selection: two geometrically compact valid scan points that remain outside the fixed s=0.81 reference surface and span different shrink strengths
repair.axis_handling: global candidate screening followed by strict selected-axis continuation
repair.parallelism: two independent one-GPU Students jobs run concurrently
